about: Planted defects in setup.sql / load.sql / gen_workload.py. Row counts in bundle/ybm_reltuples.csv are measured counts x100 (build.sh SCALE). 'engine_match' is what yb-model.py must emit; 'judge' is what a grader looks for in a free-text review. 'traps' are things a review should NOT claim.

defects.pattern: SELECT sku, qty, price FROM order_items WHERE order_id = $1 (P1, 91% of time)
defects.judge: order_items PK is HASH over (order_id, line_no); the lookup binds only order_id, so the PK cannot be used and every call scans the table. Fix: PRIMARY KEY ((order_id) HASH, line_no ASC).

defects.pattern: SELECT id FROM customers WHERE lower(email) = $1
defects.judge: Predicate applies lower() to email; the unique index is on email, so no index applies and the table is scanned. Fix: expression index on lower(email), or store normalised email.

defects.pattern: SELECT entity, detail FROM audit_log WHERE id = $1
defects.judge: audit_log is range-partitioned on created_at; lookup by id alone cannot prune, so all 4 partitions are probed.
orders_customer and orders_customer_created hash a nullable customer_id that is ~30% NULL; all NULLs share one hash code and one unsplittable tablet. Fix: partial index WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL.
Low-cardinality and skewed hash key on status: at most 4 hash codes, one holding 85% of rows. Drop or make composite.

defects.pattern: events PRIMARY KEY (id ASC) with identity id and hot inserts
defects.judge: events is range-sharded on a monotonically increasing identity, so all inserts go to the last tablet. Fix: HASH the key or bucket it.

defects.pattern: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE customer_id = $1 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20
defects.judge: Served by orders_customer_created but SELECT * forces a base-table fetch per row; project needed columns or INCLUDE them.

defects.pattern: SELECT carrier, tracking FROM shipments WHERE order_id IN (...) ORDER BY shipped_at DESC LIMIT 10
defects.judge: IN on the hash key with ORDER BY the range column needs a sort over all rows of all keys; merge scan streams (yb_max_merge_scan_streams, 0 here) would avoid it.
orders_total has idx_scan = 0 and no pattern needs it; drop after confirming no batch job uses it.

defects.pattern: orders_customer is a prefix of orders_customer_created
defects.judge: orders_customer (customer_id) is redundant with orders_customer_created (customer_id, created_at).

defects.pattern: orders: 4 secondary indexes on a write-hot table
defects.judge: orders is inserted and updated by hot patterns and carries 4 secondary indexes, each an extra write participant.

traps.claim: audit_log must have a primary key on the parent
traps.why: Per-partition PK on id is the documented shape when uniqueness is per child.
ysql_dump shows CACHE 100, the YSQL minimum default; not a defect.

traps.claim: customers_pkey or orders_pkey hash on id is a problem
customers_email unique HASH index is a hotspot
traps.why: email is unique and NOT NULL, ~2M distinct.

traps.claim: invented numbers: latencies, tablet sizes or row counts not in the bundle
